text:
emma: Quick heads-up — Community Workshops Kit v0.9.0 is published. Includes new lightweight workshop templates, updated local dev images, slide deck examples, and a tiny CLI to scaffold sessions. Release notes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-workshops/releases/tag/v0.9.0 :tada:

release-bot: Release published: community-workshops v0.9.0 — https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-workshops/releases/tag/v0.9.0 (changelog in repo)

raj: nice! any breaking changes we should know about?

emma: short answer: one small breaking change in template schema (templates/config.yaml schema bumped to v2). Migration script provided. Example to run locally:

```bash
# from repo root
./scripts/migrate-templates --in templates/ --out templates_v2/
```

marta: will the slides support i18n? we're pushing localization for EMEA partners next month.

emma: yes — slides are markdown + frontmatter. We added a translations/ folder layout and a simple i18n guide in docs/i18n.md. If you want help exporting a translation pack ping me or add an issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-workshops/issues/new

dev-rel: We're running a 45-min launch + maintainer onboarding session Friday 10am PT. Join: https://cal.com/redwood/maintainer-onboard (office hours after for migration help). I'll post the calendar invite in #eng and #community.

oliver: :tada: congrats team. Curious — how should contributors add themselves to the credits?

emma: please open a PR to CONTRIBUTORS.md with name, handle, and role. We also auto-include people who authored release notes. Also note: we've updated the repo CODE_OF_CONDUCT (link in release notes) — mandatory read for workshop leaders. @maintainers please skim before Friday.

raj: thanks — will run the migration and join Friday.

oliver: dropping a quick checklist for Friday: 1) run migrate script 2) test dev image (./dev/run.sh) 3) read CoC 4) add CONTRIBUTOR line.

emma: perfect — ty! If anyone runs into CI noise during migration DM me. We'll keep a pinned thread in the repo issues for follow-ups.

release-bot: changelog summary: 12 commits, 3 new templates, 2 bugfixes, i18n scaffold. https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-workshops/commits/v0.9.0

oliver: waving at maintainers: who wants to co-host the onboarding? :handshake:

marta: I can co-host the localization portion.

emma: thanks! Adding you to the invite.
